task_description: Turn inventory-service (currently a placeholder at HEAD 7e74216) into a production-style service: own Postgres, JPA+Flyway, atomic reservations with HELD/CONFIRMED/SHIPPED lifecycle, OAuth2 resource server (role inventory), Kafka consumer of order-events (confirmed/shipped) with inbox/retry/DLT, ShedLock expiry job; order-platform gets order.shipped + reservationId on order.confirmed + client-credentials token on the inventory client; shared root compose.yaml; docs and contract test.
